import numpy as np
def equation(eps, T, params):
    p = params
    a = p[0] + p[1]*T + p[2]/T
    b = p[3] + p[4]*T + p[5]/T
    n = p[6]
    k = p[7]
    return a + b*eps**n*np.exp(-k*eps) + p[8]*eps + p[9]*np.log(eps)*T

import numpy as np
def equation(eps, T, params):
    p = params
    a = p[0] + p[1]*T + p[2]/T + p[3]*T**2
    c1 = p[4] + p[5]/T
    c2 = p[6] + p[7]*T
    return a + c1*eps + c2*eps**2 + p[8]*np.log(eps) + p[9]*np.sqrt(eps)
